business.headline: Turn your customers' networks into your sales team
business.subhead: List your product, set your commission structure, and let Commission recruit, track, and pay affiliates automatically — in naira, through Paystack.

problemsAndSolutions.solution: Pay only for a qualified lead or verified sale - never for reach that doesn't convert.

earningsExample.title: What it looks like in naira
earningsExample.body: A ₦50,000/month SaaS subscription with a 10% recurring commission pays you ₦5,000 every month the customer stays — for as long as they're subscribed.

business.a: We take a percentage of the affiliate commission you set — never a cut of your product's sale price.

business.q: Do I need to hold a wallet balance?
business.a: Yes, for lead-goal campaigns - you pre-fund a Campaign Wallet via Paystack, and Commission deducts from it the moment a lead qualifies or a sale is verified. Direct sales still settle to you via Paystack; the wallet only covers what you owe in commissions and Commission's own fee.

business.q: Can I run more than 3 tiers?
business.a: The platform supports up to 3 affiliate tiers per program, matching how most referral structures actually work.

There's no automatic reversal yet if a customer refunds after a commission has already been paid out - this is a known gap, not a built safeguard. Worth factoring into your own numbers until it's addressed.

business.q: What is Radar, and do I have to set it up?
business.a: Radar is Commission's built-in trust layer - it checks a referring affiliate's real track record automatically and adds a quick verification step for unproven ones. Nothing to configure; it runs on every lead-goal campaign by default.

business.q: Can I capture leads on my own site instead of Commission's page?
business.a: Yes, on Medium and Large plans - a lightweight tracking script lets your own form report leads directly to Commission, no redirect to commission.ng at all.

affiliate.q: Do I need a business account to become an affiliate?
affiliate.a: No — every Commission account can promote products, list its own, or both. There is just one account type.
Commissions are paid out to your bank account via Paystack once they clear the program's minimum payout threshold.
If you refer another affiliate into a program, you earn a percentage of their sales too — up to 2 levels below you.

affiliate.q: How long does my referral link stay credited to me?
affiliate.a: Each program sets its own attribution window (commonly 30 days) from when someone clicks your link.

affiliate.q: Can I recruit other affiliates and earn from their referrals?
affiliate.a: Yes - each program gives you a separate recruitment link, distinct from your customer referral link. Anyone who joins through it becomes your sub-affiliate, up to 3 tiers deep.

affiliate.q: Does a subscription product pay commission more than once?
affiliate.a: Yes - a recurring-billing product pays commission again on every successful renewal, not just the first sale, for as long as the customer stays subscribed.
